auditor_verdict: AGREE: capacities rise from 20,480/655,360 on Aug 27 to 163,840/5,242,880 on Sep 11, while counts reach 46,522 rooms and 2,753,430 notes—9.1× and 16.8× the documented caps—supporting quota aggregation or reporting failure.
